en_title: Rockstar Pushes Back on Rumor GTA 6 Cost More Than $1.5 Billion to Make, but It's Still Probably the Most Expensive Video Game of All Time
subtitle: 仍可能是史上最贵
opus_summary: Rockstar否认《GTA6》开发预算超过哈利法塔造价，但未公布具体金额。该作仍可能是史上成本最高的游戏，公司员工数较2018年已翻倍，预计销售收入将迅速覆盖投入。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has insisted GTA 6 did not cost more than $1.5 billion to make, countering an online rumor, but it’s still probably the most expensive video game of all time.
paragraphs.cn: 针对网上流传的说法，Rockstar明确表示，《GTA6》的开发成本并未超过15亿美元(约合人民币100亿元)。不过，它仍可能是史上开发成本最高的游戏。

paragraphs.en: In a sweeping report by Bloomberg into the making of GTA 6, Rockstar head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe insisted a rumor that GTA 6’s budget was more than the $1.5 billion spent on Dubai’s Burj Khalifa was wrong, although she failed to confirm the game’s exact budget. This rumor appears to have emerged from a July 2025 article by Gulf News , which claimed “Dubai's landmark is said to have cost $1.5 billion but the game is thought to have a $2 billion budget.”
paragraphs.cn: 彭博社在一篇深入报道《GTA6》开发过程的文章中提到，Rockstar发行主管Jennifer Kolbe明确否认了该作预算超过迪拜哈利法塔15亿美元(约合人民币100亿元)造价的传闻，但她并未透露游戏的具体预算。这一传闻似乎源自Gulf News在2025年7月发表的一篇文章，文中称：「这座迪拜地标的造价据称为15亿美元(约合人民币100亿元)，而这款游戏的预算据信达到了20亿美元(约合人民币134亿元)。」

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, Business Insider suggested a $1-1.5 billion budget based on industry analyst estimations as part of an interview with Strauss Zelnick, boss of Rockstar parent company Take-Two. Zelnick wouldn’t say how much the company had spent on GTA 6 so far, but did admit “it was expensive.”
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，Business Insider在采访Rockstar母公司Take-Two负责人Strauss Zelnick时，援引行业分析师的估算，提出该作预算可能在10亿至15亿美元(约合人民币100亿元)之间。Zelnick不愿透露公司迄今为《GTA6》投入了多少钱，但承认「确实花了很多钱」。

paragraphs.en: While GTA 6 did not cost more than $1.5 billion to develop, according to Rockstar, it is considered the most expensive video game of all time. The only video game that might claim to come close to GTA 6’s budget is space sim Star Citizen, although its now over $1 billion budget comes from ongoing sales of space ships. Bungie's recently released extraction shooter reportedly had a budget of over $250 million , for example. Concord's initial development deal was around $200 million, according to a report by Kotaku . In 2023, documents submitted as part of the Xbox Federal Trade Commission case accidentally revealed The Last of Us: Part II and Horizon Forbidden West each cost more than $200 million to develop . Last year, the astronomical development budgets of the Call of Duty games were revealed for the first time after a court document confirmed Activision pumped $700 million into Black Ops Cold War alone, although that was over the shooter's life cycle. GTA 6, clearly, surpasses them all.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然Rockstar表示《GTA6》的开发成本并未超过15亿美元(约合人民币100亿元)，但它仍被视为史上开发成本最高的游戏。唯一可能在预算上接近《GTA6》的，或许是太空模拟游戏《星际公民》，不过，该作如今超过10亿美元(约合人民币67亿元)的预算来自持续销售太空飞船所得。相比之下，据报道，Bungie最近推出的撤离射击游戏预算超过2.5亿美元(约合人民币17亿元)。Kotaku的报道称，《星鸣特攻》最初签订的开发协议金额约为2亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)。2023年，XBOX与联邦贸易委员会诉讼案中提交的文件意外披露，《最后生还者2》和《地平线：西之绝境》的开发成本各自都超过了2亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)。去年，一份法院文件证实，Activision仅在《黑色行动 冷战》上就投入了7亿美元(约合人民币47亿元)，《使命召唤》系列惊人的开发预算由此首次曝光。不过，这笔投入覆盖了这款射击游戏的整个生命周期。显然，《GTA6》的成本超过了上述所有游戏。

paragraphs.en: As part of Bloomberg’s report is the confirmation that Rockstar now has 4,711 staff across 12 offices, up from the 2,441 staff it had when Red Dead Redemption 2 came out in 2018. The company has doubled in size over the last eight years, which will have increased costs significantly.
paragraphs.cn: 彭博社的报道还证实，Rockstar目前在12个办公室共有4,711名员工，而2018年《荒野大镖客：救赎2》发售时，员工数为2,441人。过去八年间，公司规模翻了一倍，成本也会因此显著增加。

paragraphs.en: As Bloomberg points out, GTA 6’s enormous budget is likely to pay off pretty quickly, with some predicting an eye-watering 40 million sales and $3 billion in revenue in the first four months of the game going on sale in November. The standard edition of GTA 6 costs $80 — a $10 hike on the standard price of a triple-A video game. The Ultimate Edition, which some consider to be an essential purchase, costs $100. Then there’s the expected launch of online multiplayer next year (maybe tied to the launch of the PC version, which is reportedly due out Q1 2027 ), which will surely boost revenue even further. In short, even if it’s just shy of $1.5 billion, GTA 6’s budget doesn’t feel like much of a risk.
paragraphs.cn: 正如彭博社所指出的，《GTA6》的巨额投入很可能很快就能收回。有人预测，该作11月发售后的前四个月，销量将达到惊人的4,000万份，收入将达30亿美元(约合人民币201亿元)。《GTA6》标准版售价80美元(约合人民币536元)，比3A游戏的常规售价高出10美元(约合人民币67元)。终极版售价100美元(约合人民币670元)，部分人认为这个版本非买不可。此外，在线多人模式预计明年推出，或许会与据称将于2027年第一季度发售的PC版同步上线，无疑还会进一步推高收入。简而言之，即便《GTA6》的预算接近15亿美元(约合人民币100亿元)，这笔投入看起来也没有多大风险。

paragraphs.en: In July, Newzoo analysis suggested GTA 6 generated approximately $180 million in digital preorders across the U.S. and the five biggest European markets during the last week of June (GTA 6 preorders went live at midnight, June 25). The analytics firm used GTA 5’s player distribution (around 69% of GTA 5's lifetime console players sit within those six markets) to then estimate global first-week preorder spending for GTA 6 at approximately $260 million. Based on comparable preorder curves, GTA 6 is currently tracking toward $3.25 billion to $5.2 billion in cumulative sales by the end of launch week, it said.
paragraphs.cn: Newzoo在7月发布的分析显示，6月最后一周，《GTA6》在美国及欧洲五大市场的数字版预购收入约为1.8亿美元(约合人民币12亿元)；该作于6月25日午夜开放预购。这家分析公司随后参考《GTA5》的玩家分布，估算《GTA6》全球首周预购消费额约为2.6亿美元(约合人民币17亿元)。《GTA5》历来约69%的主机玩家来自上述六个市场。Newzoo表示，根据可比的预购走势，《GTA6》目前有望在发售首周结束时实现32.5亿至52亿美元(约合人民币348亿元)的累计销售额。

paragraphs.en: GTA 5 set records for generating $1 billion in three days after going on sale back in 2013, making it the fastest-selling entertainment product in history (Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Endgame ran it close, making $1 billion at the global box office in five days). GTA 6 seems certain to hit the $1 billion mark faster than both. GTA 5 went on to become the second best-selling video game of all time, with nearly 230 million units sold-in to date. Only Minecraft is ahead of it. Could GTA 6 eventually surpass even Minecraft's 400 million sales?
paragraphs.cn: 2013年，《GTA5》发售三天便创下10亿美元(约合人民币67亿元)收入的纪录，成为史上销售速度最快的娱乐产品。漫威影业的《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》紧随其后，用五天实现了10亿美元(约合人民币67亿元)全球票房。《GTA6》似乎肯定会比两者更快突破10亿美元(约合人民币67亿元)大关。此后，《GTA5》成为史上销量第二高的游戏，迄今出货量接近2.3亿份，仅次于《我的世界》。《GTA6》最终能否连《我的世界》4亿份的销量也一并超越？

paragraphs.en: In other GTA 6 news, Bloomberg reported that Rockstar has promised its next game won’t take another eight years to develop , although we don’t know what it will be.
paragraphs.cn: 关于《GTA6》的其他消息，彭博社报道称，Rockstar承诺下一款游戏不会再花八年时间开发，不过我们还不知道那会是什么作品。
